identity_and_concept.title: Senior Software Developer — Fintech, Enterprise Banking, Market Data, Desktop & AI Products
identity_and_concept.aesthetic_notes: Awwwards-level dark editorial design. Deep graphite canvas with charcoal surfaces, fine hairline grid rules, numbered section identifiers (01 //, 02 //), clean mono metadata, and ultra-large display grotesk headings. Stripped of generic SaaS gradients, neon cyberpunk, or rounded-card overload. Controlled vivid amber/orange signal accent used with extreme restraint.
identity_and_concept.theme_support: Dark mode by default (#0E0F12), with a warm-paper light mode (#F7F6F2) toggle with persistent state in localStorage.

device_mockups.iphone: CSS iPhone 15 Pro frame container with dynamic island top notch, sleek rounded bezel, ambient shadow, and dark mode screenshots.
device_mockups.desktop_pc: macOS / Windows style browser & application container with red/yellow/green top bar dots, title header, crisp dark UI software mockups.

editorial_cards.style: Hairline 1px border cards (border-white/10 dark, border-black/10 light), subtle background tint on hover, amber status badges, top mono project index (01 //, 02 //).

sticky_navigation.style: Glassmorphism navigation (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0E0F12]/85 dark, bg-[#F7F6F2]/85 light), non-transparent border-b, top glowing amber scroll progress bar, theme switcher, mobile sheet drawer.

contact_form.style: Minimalist underline/boxed inputs, active amber focus rings, submit state with Sonner toast notification, direct mailto fallback link.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies like lenis (@studio-freight/lenis or lenis), framer-motion, lucide-react, sonner if missing.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-theme-toggle', data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
Maintain strict dark/light mode consistency across all pages and routes.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns—always add backdrop-blur and semi-opaque background color.
For case study pages, implement smooth sticky mini-nav jumps to section IDs (#overview, #scope, #build, #outcomes, #stack).
Ensure full accessibility and reduced motion options via Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_quality: High-craft Awwwards-level visual direction. Deep contrast, hairline grid borders, strict spacing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.button_styles: Pill or sharp rectangular buttons with subtle hover lift and signal amber highlight.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_ids: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive elements in kebab-case.
